_doc: Magic item generator data (magic_items_revamp.md, built by scripts/magic-items/build_magic_items.py; do not hand-edit pools). Tier = price window in M: consumables = sum of spell charge prices, wands/staves = charge x charges (1..max_charges), prices from fight/spell_value.json. Item level gates use; a spell joins if its level <= item level + level_reach. cast level = item level + cast_offset. aoe: never | group_only (GROUP_OK spells) | rare+ | always.
